anomaly_signals.detail: 609 errors out of 1000 spans — 60.9% error rate. Likely cascading failures from downstream DB and auth degradation.
224 errors out of 1000 spans (22.4%). Strongly correlated with postgres-auth degradation under db_incident scenario.
112 errors out of 1000 spans (11.2%). Database-layer failures consistent with active db_incident scenario.
225 errors out of 470 spans (47.9%) and 232 genai_tool_failures recorded across the batch — nearly half of all tool invocations are failing.
204 errors out of 466 spans (43.8%). Likely driven by tool-executor failures and downstream instability propagating into agent workflows.
118 errors out of 418 spans (28.2%). Paired with 84 postgres-payments errors, indicating DB-layer failures impacting payment processing.
84 errors out of 418 spans (20.1%). Confirms db_incident is impacting the payments database, not just auth.
93 errors out of 466 spans (20.0%). Elevated error rate likely related to DB incident affecting persistence layer.
90 errors out of 868 spans (10.4%). P99 latency across the stack is 27,233ms — LLM service is a contributing factor to tail latency.
24 genai_token_truncations detected. While not critical, truncations may degrade response quality under high-latency/retry conditions.

recommended_action: Immediately investigate and remediate the db_incident on both postgres-auth and postgres-payments — these are the root cause driving cascading failures across api-gateway (60.9% errors), auth-service, payments-service, and memory-service. Simultaneously, triage tool-executor (47.9% failure rate / 232 tool failures) as it is independently destabilising agent workflows. Consider circuit-breaking DB-dependent services and routing LLM traffic away from degraded tool paths until DB stability is restored.
summary: A confirmed db_incident is causing widespread cascading failures across the stack, with an overall error rate of 23.8% and a p99 latency of ~27.2 seconds. The api-gateway (60.9% errors), auth-service, payments-service, and both Postgres backends are critically impacted, while tool-executor is independently failing at ~48% rate with 232 genAI tool failures and 24 token truncations compounding agent-layer degradation.
